reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: active non-test caller exists at MemberManagementClient.tsx:680. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attack path is an admin-initiated server action with no trusted-source bypass applicable. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/ is explicitly in scope. The target repo's own CLAUDE.md documents that createClient() (SSR client) causes RLS to evaluate as 'authenticated' role, silently returning 0 rows for UPDATE/DELETE without an error — confirming the silent no-op. An attacker (or retained member) can exploit this by having an admin invoke deleteMember(targetUserId) via the dashboard; the SSR client's UPDATE at members.ts:524-527 is blocked silently by RLS, the error check at L529 passes (error is null), the function reports success, but deleted_at remains null, allowing the 'deleted' member to continue authenticating and accessing the system indefinitely.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-011: Soft delete must set deleted_at timestamp; row must not be physically removed from database.
